modules.title: Signing requests
modules.intro: Only you (and administrators) can see the requests you create.
modules.disclaimer: Signatures here are simple electronic acknowledgements: signers confirm by typing their name through a private link. HN Group does not verify their identity beyond possession of that link, and this is not a qualified or advanced electronic signature. Consider whether that is appropriate for your document.
